Oiii white tigers r kinda overrated in my opinion🥺🥺💔 they’re one of my least favorite coats of tigers but I still think they’re gorgeous  ♯IB: @/chundoona ♯ A white tiger is not a separate species or albino, but rather a Bengal or Siberian tiger (there has been no recorded cases of a white, purebred Siberian tiger) carrying a rare recessive genetic mutation (leucism) that removes orange fur pigmentation while leaving dark stripes and blue eyes. Occurring naturally in about 1 in 10,000 births, they have been considered extinct in the wild since the last known individual was shot in 1958, leaving a small population of roughly 200 animals restricted to captive facilities and zoos. Because profit-driven captive breeding programs heavily rely on inbreeding to pass on the recessive trait, white tigers frequently suffer from high cub mortality rates, cross-eyed conditions, skeletal deformities, and other severe health issues. #tiger #pantheriatigris #whitetiger #fyp #tigeredit
